## What's Changed

* [Bug #22188: addr2line doesn't find symbols when compiled with GCC LTO - Ruby - Ruby Issue Tracking System](https://bugs.ruby-lang.org/issues/22188)
* [Bug #22210: Check if issue #19969 is still reproducible / re-opened in 4.0.x - Ruby - Ruby Issue Tracking System](https://bugs.ruby-lang.org/issues/22210)
* [Bug #22217: Segmentation fault when resuming execution with `Coverage.start` and ruby/debug - Ruby - Ruby Issue Tracking System](https://bugs.ruby-lang.org/issues/22217)
* [Fix formatting in ObjectSpace._id2ref error path by eregon · Pull Request #18206](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/18206)
* [Bug #22200: ObjectSpace._id2ref can return a different object than the id's owner on Ruby 4.0 (stale id2ref_tbl entry for objects with generic fields) - Ruby - Ruby Issue Tracking System](https://bugs.ruby-lang.org/issues/22200)
* [Bug #22123: Ruby::Box + `BUNDLER_SETUP` can evaluate gemspecs before main-box RubyGems initialization - Ruby - Ruby Issue Tracking System](https://bugs.ruby-lang.org/issues/22123)
* [Bump ERB to 6.0.7 by k0kubun · Pull Request #18282](https://github.com/ruby/ruby/pull/18282)
* [Bug #22237: GC.auto_compact corrupts a String or segfaults from String#tr with dup or gsub - Ruby - Ruby Issue Tracking System](https://bugs.ruby-lang.org/issues/22237)
* [Bug #22243: Change fork behavior when Process._fork raises an exception during fork with a block argument - Ruby - Ruby Issue Tracking System](https://bugs.ruby-lang.org/issues/22243)
* [Bug #22223: Socket.tcp with connect_timeout returns a phantom "connected" socket for a refused connection on macOS 27 (kernel answers EISCONN on connect retry; SO_ERROR never consulted) - Ruby - Ruby Issue Tracking System](https://bugs.ruby-lang.org/issues/22223)
* [Bug #22220: Performance regression when requiring `aws-sdk-ec2` in Ruby 4.0.6 - Ruby - Ruby Issue Tracking System](https://bugs.ruby-lang.org/issues/22220)
* [Bug #22218: Line TracePoint misses executed loop condition after a guard - Ruby - Ruby Issue Tracking System](https://bugs.ruby-lang.org/issues/22218)
* [Bug #22198: win32: heap overflow in Kernel#system - Ruby - Ruby Issue Tracking System](https://bugs.ruby-lang.org/issues/22198)
* [Bug #22196: Heap-use-after-free in `fiber_switch` with transfer-terminated async tasks on 3.4.10 - Ruby - Ruby Issue Tracking System](https://bugs.ruby-lang.org/issues/22196)
* [Bug #22190: Class#subclasses does not include clones of classes that include modules - Ruby - Ruby Issue Tracking System](https://bugs.ruby-lang.org/issues/22190)
* [Bug #11438: native_thread_init_stack() get machine.stack_start unequal to thread's stack start address, x86 win32 - Ruby - Ruby Issue Tracking System](https://bugs.ruby-lang.org/issues/11438)
* [Bug #22257: Prepending a module to an already-included module leaves stale super caches - Ruby - Ruby Issue Tracking System](https://bugs.ruby-lang.org/issues/22257)
* [Bug #22242: SEGV in method dispatch (`vm_call_iseq_setup_kwparm_nokwarg` / `def_iseq_ptr`) on Ruby 4.0.6 — Rails CI - Ruby - Ruby Issue Tracking System](https://bugs.ruby-lang.org/issues/22242)
* [Bug #22269: `Coverage.line_stub` clobbers already-collected coverage data - Ruby - Ruby Issue Tracking System](https://bugs.ruby-lang.org/issues/22269)
* [Bug #22290: Adding instance variables to anonymous object may bloat all future classes - Ruby - Ruby Issue Tracking System](https://bugs.ruby-lang.org/issues/22290)
* [Bug #22292: YJIT/ZJIT: Struct accessor crashes after an instance variable is set on a Struct that exactly fills the largest GC slot - Ruby - Ruby Issue Tracking System](https://bugs.ruby-lang.org/issues/22292)
* [Bug #20958: fix ENV.keys encoding on windows - Ruby - Ruby Issue Tracking System](https://bugs.ruby-lang.org/issues/20958)
* [Bug #22259: Arrays sharding a buffer segfault when concatenating with each other - Ruby - Ruby Issue Tracking System](https://bugs.ruby-lang.org/issues/22259)
* [Bug #22264: Warning missing from parse.y hash literals - Ruby - Ruby Issue Tracking System](https://bugs.ruby-lang.org/issues/22264)
* [Bug #22303: EncodingError from interpolating symbol crashes whole process - Ruby - Ruby Issue Tracking System](https://bugs.ruby-lang.org/issues/22303)
* [Bug #22224: YJIT: rb_yjit_invalidate_ep_is_bp takes the VM lock stopping Ractors on every Proc materialization; multi-Ractor throughput collapses (up to ~150x) - Ruby - Ruby Issue Tracking System](https://bugs.ruby-lang.org/issues/22224)

Note: This list is automatically generated by tool/gen-github-release.rb. Because of this, some commits may be missing.
